principles: Host-neutral workflow commands remain independent of Codex or any single host.
Learning artifacts must not become lifecycle proof evidence or DONE gate inputs.
Candidate playbooks stay pending learning until explicit human/operator activation.
Every state transition performed by the sweep must be idempotent and auditable.
Implement only V1 correctness gaps from the plan, not speculative optimization.
drivers: Need to finish candidate assessment/rejection/non-deducible loop without weakening evidence boundaries.
Existing B-dddd outcome ledger provides explicit settled outcome events that can feed aggregation.
Runtime memory work is concurrently owned by B-ec3b, so this story must avoid active runtime pack changes.

options.name: A: deterministic local sweep with explicit apply and advisory recommendations
pros: Matches V1 plan boundary and keeps automatic activation out of scope
Can be tested with pure local fixtures and smoke tests
Keeps recommendations/rejections/non-deducible markings auditable and idempotent
cons: Does not fully automate activation; operator still must activate separately
Sparse local samples may hold candidates longer

options.name: B: automatic promotion worker that mutates candidate to active
pros: Would close activation loop and reduce operator steps
cons: Risks turning local learning into runtime guidance without explicit review
Would touch B-ec3b runtime memory scope

options.name: C: matched-control trial traffic and timer daemon
pros: Richer statistical signal and automatic recurring sweep
cons: Requires serving changes and background scheduling outside this story
Increases risk and review surface without current necessity

chosen: A: deterministic local sweep with explicit apply and advisory recommendations
rationale: Choose the deterministic local sweep because it closes the V1 assessment loop while preserving Proofbound evidence boundaries and avoiding automatic activation.

preMortem.scenario: Candidate recommendations leak into active runtime guidance
preMortem.trigger: status/session surfaces reuse runtime memory pack fields
preMortem.consequence: Agents treat candidate material as active advice
preMortem.mitigation: Keep status output separate and avoid runtime memory pack changes

preMortem.scenario: DONE settlement falsely credits a candidate
preMortem.trigger: implementation equates story DONE with helped outcome
preMortem.consequence: Bad candidates can be recommended from unrelated success
preMortem.mitigation: Require explicit exposure and structured verdict for helped outcomes; post-DONE hook is learning-only/no-op unless eligible

preMortem.scenario: Apply sweep is rerun and duplicates decisions
preMortem.consequence: Audit log becomes noisy and downstream status misleading
preMortem.mitigation: Use deterministic aggregate digest/idempotency key and skip duplicate decision rows
